I have a problem with an application i am trying to fix in Shiny! The basic idea is to text words and then to press a button submit(i have already done). After this to be able to change the order of words in each line. How can i have access to each line in the matrix i created??

this is my code.. Thank you a lot in advance for your time!

Server:

library(shiny)
library(shinyAce)


shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  
  get.text <- reactive({
    input$text
  })  
  
  output$dataframe <- renderTable({
    read.table(text=get.text(),fill=TRUE,row.names=NULL,header=FALSE)
    })
  
  
  Data <- reactive({
    infile<-output$dataframe
  })
  
})
